title: fix(components,types): eight renderers stop reading undeclared node keys; input-otp and loading read their declared spellings (objectui#11347)
body:
Refs #11347
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

The `@object-ui/components` preparation unit of objectui#8347 (the parent, which removes `BaseSchema`'s index signature and lands last). It covers the twelve un-cast reads in eight renderers that objectui#8347's P1 mutation reddens. Each key was measured on its own. Ten reads are retired and two move to the spelling the type already declares. No key is declared. 64 of the package's 94 test errors are retyped to their concrete node types. The other 30 stay, and are handed back below. One of them is objectui#8347's own probe flip. The other 29 author nodes that have no TypeScript declaration at all, which is a fork, so this PR says `Refs`.

## Per-key verdicts

Spec row: the installed `@objectstack/spec` is 17.5.0. Its `ComponentPropsMap` (55 entries) has no row for any of the eight node types. A grep of the whole installed package finds zero hits for `shouldScaleBackground`, `showClose`, `input-otp` and `dropdown-menu`. The control `modalCloseButton` hits three files, so the grep was reading.

Producers: I searched `examples/schema-catalog` (every entry of these eight node types, key by key), `examples/*`, `content/docs/**`, every package README, `skills/`, `packages/types/examples`, and objectstack `origin/main` `2742e5370` (examples and packages). None of them authors any of the nine read keys. The objectstack hits for `type: 'list'` and `type: 'drawer'` are page types, flow variables and a form-view type, not component nodes. The only places that name these keys are the registrations' own `inputs` and `defaultProps`. None of the eight types is in `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`, so those entries never reach the published `sdui.manifest.json`.

Runtime: each key was rendered through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry, before and after the change, in a scratch probe that is not committed.

| node | key (reads) | rule | verdict | through `SchemaRenderer`, before then after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list` | `title` (2) | 3 | retired | a heading with the title, then no heading |
| `loading` | `text` (2) | 3 + near spelling | read moves to the declared `LoadingSchema.label`; `text` retired, no alias | `text`: a message, then none. `label`: no message, then a message |
| `input-otp` | `maxLength` (TS2551) | 3 + near spelling | read moves to the declared `InputOTPSchema.length` | `length: 4`: 6 slots, then 4. `length: 8`: 6, then 8. `maxLength: 4`: 4, then 6 |
| `sidebar-menu-button` | `active` (read off `BaseSchema` itself; no node type exists) | 3 | retired | `data-active="true"`, then `"false"` |
| `drawer` | `footer` | 3 | retired | footer drawn, then none |
| `drawer` | `showClose` | 3 | retired | 1 Close button, then 0 |
| `drawer` | `shouldScaleBackground` | 3 | named read retired | the vaul root receives the authored `false` both before and after, through the prop spread |
| `dropdown-menu`, `popover`, `sheet` | `modal` (1 each) | 3 | named read retired | the Radix root receives the authored value both before and after, through the prop spread |

H3, the near spelling, measured before anything moved. The `input-otp` producers spell it `length`: all five catalog entries and the docs page. The type declares `length` on both faces, with `@default 6`. So the read moved, not the declaration. The published 4-digit and 8-digit examples used to draw six slots. `loading` has the same shape: `LoadingSchema.label` ("Loading text/message", on both faces) was inert while an undeclared `text` was read. Neither spelling has a producer, so the read moved to the declared key instead of dropping the message feature. That move is an in-place fix under the same near-spelling class. The seat can reverse it to a plain retirement.

An independent instrument agrees. On `pnpm check:component-surface-parity` (objectui#4631, report-only), base `770cc5ba4` was read in a detached control worktree:
- `interface-missing-key` goes from 59 to 49. The ten rows that go are exactly these keys.
- `interface-extra-key` goes from 121 to 120, because `input-otp.length` is now read.
- The total goes from 250 to 239.

## P1 measurement (H1)

The un-chained recipe is `tsc --noEmit`, then `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. It ran with objectui#8347's mutation applied through `ablation-replace` and `@object-ui/types` rebuilt. The restore is proven each time: the blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` on `base.ts` is empty, and the dist count is back to 2.

| tree | src program | test program |
|---|---|---|
| base `770cc5ba4`, mutated | 12 | 106 (12 of them the same source sites, so 94 test errors in 20 files) |
| head `bba957503`, mutated | **0** | **30** |
| base and head, signature present (control) | 0 | 0 |

## The tests (H4)

64 literals are now typed as the nodes they are, through a small typed identity per file (`actionBar`, `textNode`, `selectNode`, and so on). Excess-property checking runs against the concrete type, not against `BaseSchema`. ⛔ The helpers are not generic, so they cannot widen anything. The button `variant` and `size` tables and the input `inputType` table are typed with the declared unions.

The 30 left, by file:
- **objectui#8347's probe flip (1):** `form-renderers.test.tsx`, where `label` authors its retired `content` spelling on purpose.
- **No TypeScript node type exists (29).** They are handed back as a fork, neither cast nor widened. TS2353 names only the first excess key of each literal, so more keys may surface once a type exists.
  - `element:text` / `element:text_input` / `element:record_picker`, through their `properties` bag:
    - `page-variables.test.tsx` (5, one of them `dataSource`)
    - `text-input.test.tsx` (5)
    - `text-input-description-association.test.tsx` (1)
    - `required-marker-markup.test.tsx` (1)
    - `record-picker-label-association.test.tsx` (1)
  - `page:tabs`' `items`: `page-tabs-builtin-label-i18n-4645.test.tsx` (2) and `chrome-i18n-no-provider-fallback.test.tsx` (1).
  - The executor keys of `action:button` (`actionType`): `action-params-templates-7867.test.tsx` (5). `UIActionSchema` is the action definition, not the node. Its `type` is the executor union.
  - The page kind `home` with `kind`: `html-page-lazy-blocks.test.tsx` (1) and `react-page-scope.test.tsx` (1). `PageNodeSchema` is `type: 'page'` only.
  - The legacy `props` alias bag: `alias-precedence-cross-channel.test.tsx` (4).
  - A type that only the test registers, with `properties`: `degenerate-config-bag.test.tsx` (2).
  - Measured: the spec's own `PageComponent`, re-exported here as `SpecPageComponent`, is NOT assignable to `SchemaRenderer`'s `schema` under P1 (TS2322). So "retype to the spec type" does not work either.

## Files outside the claimed surface

Each was forced by a verdict above. None appears in the file list of any of the 16 open PRs, read before the first edit.
- `packages/types/src/crud.ts`: the `CRUDDialogSchema.showClose` docblock named the drawer's look-alike `showClose` read as live, cited by a cross-file line address. It now records the read as retired, cited by path.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/layout-default-jsdoc-7361.test.ts`: it pinned that the drawer reads `schema.showClose`. It now pins the retirement, with a firing control.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/__tests__/node-slot-numeric-falsy.test.tsx`: the `drawer footer` row pinned the retired slot, so it is removed and the table docblock says why.
- `.changeset/8318-jsdoc-default-tag-corrections.md`: a dated correction is appended. The frontmatter is byte-identical.

Overlaps with open PRs are textual and mergeable:
- objectui#11341 re-fences `loading.mdx` and `input-otp.mdx`. It changes only the fence line, and the edits here are on other lines.
- objectui#11351 and objectui#11352 edit `form.ts` / `form.zod.ts` in the `FormField` / `FormSchema` regions. The edits here are in `InputOTPSchema`.

## Gates, at head `bba957503`

- Build: `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/components^...' build` exited 0 (at base). `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build` exited 0 (at head).
- Type check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exited 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exited 0.
- `vitest run packages/components/`: 348 files passed and 1 skipped; 3478 tests passed and 24 skipped.
- `vitest run packages/types/`: 309 files and 7819 tests passed.
- `vitest run` on `examples/schema-catalog/` + `widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx` + `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: 38 files and 2677 tests passed.
- These checks exited 0: `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims` (report-only; the paragraph it flagged in the objectui#8318 changeset is corrected), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import` and `check:vi-mock-specifiers`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exited 0 and `check-changeset-no-major` exited 0.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (32 paths) says NOT GOVERNED.
- Narrowed lint:
  - The population is the 28 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files, all inside `eslint.config.js`'s `**/*.{ts,tsx}` block.
  - `--format json` reports 28 files, 0 errors and 73 warnings, and the same 28 files at base report 0 errors and 73 warnings (all `no-explicit-any`).
  - Invariance: the config sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off, and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the disk. A change here cannot move an untouched file's verdict.
  - The full `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- NOT MEASURED, declared to CI:
  - `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples`: exit 2, prerequisite not met (a build of 34 packages). The docs edits here are in `plaintext` fences and callouts, and no catalog JSON changed.
  - `check:sdui-registration-pins`: exit 2, prerequisite not met (a console build).

## Acceptance notes (observed, not filed)

- `SchemaRenderer` still spreads unread node keys onto the component as props. An authored `modal` or `shouldScaleBackground` therefore still reaches the Radix or vaul root. An authored `title` on `list` becomes a DOM `title` attribute on the list element, and `text` / `label` on `loading` become DOM attributes on its wrapper. Refusing the keys is the strict face's job (objectui#8345, objectui#11070). Keeping attributes off the DOM is the bare-spread family's job. These retirements change neither path.
- Family consistency: `DialogSchema` and `ContextMenuSchema` declare `modal`, and `SheetSchema` and `DialogSchema` declare `footer`, under the earlier practice of declaring what the renderer reads. Rule 3 retires the same keys on these four nodes. The objectui#4631 authority order, under which the TypeScript interface follows what the renderer reads, holds either way.
- `LoadingSchema.size`: the declared union is `'sm' | 'default' | 'lg'`, and the renderer branches on `sm` / `md` / `lg` / `xl`. NOT MEASURED, because the probe read the wrong element.

## Finding for the seat to file

- **class (c).** `input-otp` `separator` is authored by `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/components-form-input-otp/with-visual-separator.json`, by `verification-form.json`, and by the docs interface block. No type declares it and no renderer reads it.
  - reach: the docs page's "With Separator" example. The catalog entry rendered through `SchemaRenderer` draws 0 separator elements.
  - Dedupe words: `input-otp separator undeclared` · `with-visual-separator renders no separator` · `InputOTPSchema separator`.
